newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA cotton export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net Upland sales of 65,400 running bales (RB) were 63 percent below the previous week. Major increases for Mexico (33,500 RB), Turkey (13,000 RB), Taiwan (6,200 MT), and Guatemala (6,200 RB) were partially offset by transfers to the 1998/99 marketing year of 18,400 RB for Venezuela.

Exports of 104,500 RB were one-tenth below prior week and the 4-week average. Asian destinations accounted for 51 percent of the week's shipments; Western Hemisphere, 39 percent; West European, 6 percent; and the Former Soviet Union, 4 percent.
The major recipient were Mexico (27,100 RB), China (13,500 RB), Japan (9,700 RB), and Taiwan (7,200 RB).
